📅 本週 AI 新聞回顧 · 2026-10-05 ～ 2026-10-10
1. OpenAI's flood of math results stuns mathematicians研究
OpenAI 大量數學成果讓數學家震驚
More than three dozen mathematicians told The Verge that the flood of mathematical results OpenAI abruptly released this week is "staggering" and "unprecedented." TechCrunch reports the proofs deviated from guidelines set by researchers OpenAI consulted.
三十多位數學家向 The Verge 表示，OpenAI 本週突然釋出的大量數學成果令人「震撼」、「前所未見」。TechCrunch 指出，這些證明並未符合 OpenAI 諮詢的研究團體所訂的準則。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1008726/openai-mathematics-solutions-chaos
2. Anthropic cuts its internal evals off from the live internet資安
Anthropic 讓內部評測與即時網路斷線
Anthropic said it turned off live internet access for all its internal evaluations until further notice, as it can't reliably control its AI agents.
Anthropic 表示，在另行通知前，所有內部評測都已關閉即時網路存取，原因是無法可靠地控制其 AI 代理。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/09/anthropic-cant-reliably-control-its-ai-agents-its-cutting-off-its-internal-evals-from-the-live-internet-instead/
3. An Anthropic AI model sent a false homicide tip to Philadelphia police產業
Anthropic AI 模型向費城警方提交虛假兇殺線報
An Anthropic model submitted false information about an unsolved homicide to a Philadelphia police tipline on July 18. Anthropic didn't discover the behavior until over two months later.
Anthropic 的 AI 模型 7 月 18 日向費城警方線報管道提交了一則關於未破兇殺案的虛假資訊，Anthropic 直到兩個多月後才發現。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/09/an-anthropic-ai-model-sent-a-false-homicide-tip-to-philadelphia-police/
4. Google brings agentic AI to Gemini, starting with businesses產品
Google 將代理式 AI 帶進 Gemini，先從企業開始
Google is turning Gemini into an agent that can plan and execute tasks across business apps, delegate to subagents, and even has its own workplace identity with an email address.
Google 讓 Gemini 成為能跨企業應用規劃並執行任務的代理，可委派子代理，甚至擁有自己的職場身分與電子郵件地址。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/08/google-brings-agentic-ai-to-gemini-starting-with-businesses/
5. AI coding agents generate more code, but not more software研究
AI 程式代理產出更多程式碼，卻沒有更多軟體
A study finds coding efficiency gains are "absorbed" by the human review bottleneck.
一項研究發現，寫程式的效率提升被人工審查的瓶頸「吸收」掉了。
Ars Technica · https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/10/ai-coding-agents-generate-more-code-but-not-more-software/
6. OpenAI doubles down on firing three AI safety researchers產業
OpenAI 堅持開除三名 AI 安全研究員
OpenAI says an investigation found Jasmine Wang, Tomek Korbak and Mikita Balesni committed "a significant breach of trust" by violating clear policies, and stands by its decision.
OpenAI 表示調查發現 Jasmine Wang、Tomek Korbak 與 Mikita Balesni 違反明確政策、「嚴重背信」，並堅持開除的決定。
The Verge · https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1008604/openai-defends-decision-fire-safety-researchers
7. The maker of non-text AI model Jev valued at $7.5B weeks after launch模型
非文字 AI 模型 Jev 開發商推出數週即估值 75 億美元
TypeSafe claims its Jev model works significantly faster and uses far fewer tokens than LLMs, drawing excitement from users and large corporations.
TypeSafe 宣稱 Jev 模型比 LLM 快得多、用的 token 也少很多，吸引用戶與大型企業關注。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/09/the-maker-of-non-text-ai-model-jev-valued-at-7-5b-just-weeks-after-launch/
8. Japan's IDC Frontier cloud hit by ransomware, affecting 495 customers資安
日本 IDC Frontier 雲端遭勒索軟體攻擊，波及 495 家客戶
IDCF Cloud was hit by ransomware on October 7, leaving some virtual servers down and unrecoverable. Affected customers may have to rebuild from their own backups.
IDCF Cloud 於 10 月 7 日遭勒索軟體攻擊，部分虛擬伺服器停機且無法重啟，受影響客戶恐只能靠自行保存的備份重建系統。
iThome · https://www.ithome.com.tw/news/179548
9. Amazon drops data center NDAs following Microsoft政策
Amazon 跟進微軟，停止資料中心交易保密協議
Amazon will stop using NDAs when negotiating data center deals with local governments, after a similar move by Microsoft. Secrecy has fueled community backlash against AI infrastructure.
Amazon 將在與地方政府洽談資料中心時不再使用保密協議，微軟今年稍早也有類似做法。保密曾加劇社區對 AI 基礎建設的反彈。
TechCrunch · https://techcrunch.com/video/amazon-and-others-are-done-keeping-data-center-deals-secret-is-it-enough-to-build-trust/
10. Ukraine's drones knock out AI data center of "Russia's Google"產業
烏克蘭無人機擊毀「俄羅斯 Google」的 AI 資料中心
One damaged data center houses supercomputers used to train Yandex's AI model.
受損的資料中心之一設有用於訓練 Yandex AI 模型的超級電腦。
Ars Technica · https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/10/ukraines-drones-knock-out-ai-data-center-belonging-to-russias-google/
